title: Quality Leadership & Integration
outline: NAHQ CPHQ Detailed Content Outline (2024 R2b, in 2026 handbook)

questions.task_name: Provide consultative support to the governing body and key stakeholders regarding their roles and responsibilities related to quality improvement
questions.stem: A hospital's board asks who holds ultimate accountability for the quality and safety of care delivered in the organization. What is the BEST answer?

options.A: The Chief Executive Officer
options.B: The governing body (board)
options.C: The Director of Quality
options.D: The Medical Executive Committee

questions.explanation_en: The governing body has final accountability; it delegates responsibility to executives and medical staff.
questions.explanation_ar: مجلس الإدارة هو المسؤول النهائي عن الجودة والسلامة.

questions.task_name: Align quality and safety activities with strategic goals
questions.stem: A unit manager proposes a new QI project on reducing linen costs. Before chartering the project, what should the quality professional do FIRST?

options.A: Form a team now and begin collecting baseline linen-use data
options.B: Request funding from finance before scoping the project
options.C: Benchmark linen costs against national comparative data
options.D: Assess how the project aligns with strategic priorities

questions.explanation_en: Projects should first be screened for strategic fit and priority before resources are committed.
questions.explanation_ar: أولاً تحقق من ارتباط المشروع بالأولويات الاستراتيجية.

questions.task_name: Advise leadership on organizational improvement opportunities
questions.stem: During a SWOT analysis, the team notes that a new national value-based payment program will start next year. How should this be classified?

options.A: Strength, because the hospital already reports quality data
options.B: Weakness (internal factor)
options.C: Internal process gap needing a corrective action plan
options.D: Opportunity or threat (external factor)

questions.explanation_en: Regulatory or payment changes are external environment factors, so they are Opportunities or Threats.
questions.explanation_ar: العوامل التنظيمية الخارجية تُصنّف فرصاً أو تهديدات.

questions.task_name: Assess the organization's culture of quality and safety
questions.stem: After a hospital launched a safety culture initiative, voluntary incident reports increased 40% over six months while harm events stayed stable. What is the MOST likely interpretation?

options.A: Patient safety on the units has measurably deteriorated
options.B: The reporting system is being misused to settle conflicts
options.C: Staff trust in the reporting system has improved
options.D: Event definitions changed

questions.explanation_en: More reporting with stable harm usually reflects improved reporting culture and psychological safety.
questions.explanation_ar: زيادة البلاغات مع ثبات الضرر تعني تحسّن ثقافة الإبلاغ.

questions.task_name: Engage stakeholders to promote quality and safety
questions.stem: A new CEO wants to understand front-line safety concerns firsthand and visibly show commitment to safety. Which approach is MOST effective?

options.A: Sending a monthly CEO email stating that safety is the top priority
options.B: Annual survey review by the board
options.C: Asking managers to channel concerns upward through the chain of command
options.D: Regular safety WalkRounds with follow-up and feedback to staff

questions.explanation_en: WalkRounds put leaders where care happens and build trust only when concerns are tracked and closed. One-way messages and filtered reports do not engage staff.
questions.explanation_ar: جولات القيادة الميدانية مع متابعة الإجراءات تبني الثقة وتُشرك الموظفين.
questions.source: replaced old Q5 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Provide consultative support to the governing body and key stakeholders regarding their roles and responsibilities related to quality improvement
questions.stem: The quality director is preparing a quarterly quality report for the board. Which format is MOST appropriate?

options.A: Detailed unit-level raw data tables for every measure collected
options.B: Copies of all incident reports filed during the quarter for review
options.C: A concise dashboard of strategic measures with trends and targets
options.D: Minutes from every department quality meeting held that quarter

questions.explanation_en: Boards need strategic, trended, summarized information to perform oversight.
questions.explanation_ar: المجلس يحتاج ملخصاً استراتيجياً بالاتجاهات والأهداف.

questions.task_name: Engage stakeholders to promote quality and safety
questions.stem: Several surgeons resist adopting a new surgical safety checklist. What is the BEST initial strategy?

options.A: Report the surgeons to the CEO
options.B: Make checklist use a condition of employment effective immediately
options.C: Remove the checklist and choose a less controversial safety project
options.D: Engage a respected physician champion and share peer data

questions.explanation_en: Physician engagement works best through peer champions and credible data, not coercion.
questions.explanation_ar: إشراك طبيب مناصر وعرض البيانات أفضل من الإجبار.

questions.task_name: Assist with the development of action plans or projects
questions.stem: In a RACI chart for a sepsis bundle project, which statement is CORRECT?

options.A: Several leaders should share Accountability for each task
options.B: Informed parties approve all work
options.C: Consulted and Informed roles mean the same thing in practice
options.D: Only one person should be Accountable for each task

questions.explanation_en: Each task has exactly one Accountable owner; several may be Responsible.
questions.explanation_ar: لكل مهمة شخص واحد فقط مسؤول نهائياً (Accountable).

questions.task_name: Promote engagement and inter-professional teamwork
questions.stem: ICU nurses and physicians report frequent miscommunication during daily rounds, and several plans of care were unclear to nurses. What is the BEST improvement?

options.A: Ask nurses to page physicians after rounds whenever a plan is unclear
options.B: Hold separate physician rounds and nursing rounds to save time
options.C: Structured interdisciplinary rounds with a shared daily-goals checklist
options.D: Send a memo reminding physicians to write clearer progress notes

questions.explanation_en: Structured interprofessional rounds with shared goals improve team communication and role clarity. Separating disciplines or relying on memos keeps the silos.
questions.explanation_ar: الجولات متعددة التخصصات بقائمة أهداف يومية مشتركة تعزّز العمل الفريقي.
questions.source: replaced old Q9 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Align quality and safety activities with strategic goals
questions.stem: An organization wants to link its strategic goals to unit-level objectives across four perspectives, including learning & growth. Which tool BEST fits?

options.A: Balanced Scorecard
options.B: Pareto chart ranked by department
options.C: Fishbone diagram of strategic causes
options.D: Control chart of monthly targets

questions.explanation_en: The Balanced Scorecard links strategy across Financial, Customer, Internal Process, and Learning & Growth perspectives.
questions.explanation_ar: بطاقة الأداء المتوازن تربط الاستراتيجية بأربعة محاور.

questions.task_name: Assist with establishing priorities
questions.stem: The quality committee received 12 improvement requests but can resource only 3 this year. What is the BEST approach?

options.A: Select the projects requested by the most senior leaders first
options.B: Use criteria-based prioritization (strategic fit, risk, impact)
options.C: Start all 12 projects at once using smaller part-time teams
options.D: Choose the 3 easiest projects so results come quickly this year

questions.explanation_en: Objective, criteria-based prioritization ensures resources go to the highest-value, strategically aligned work.
questions.explanation_ar: استخدم معايير موضوعية لترتيب الأولويات.

questions.task_name: Identify resource needs to improve quality
questions.stem: Before presenting a CLABSI-reduction project proposal to the executive team, what should the quality professional prepare to secure support?

options.A: A list of staff members linked to each infection in the past year
options.B: Required resources and the expected clinical and financial return
options.C: Only the national CLABSI benchmark and the unit's current rate
options.D: A request to postpone the project until the next fiscal year begins

questions.explanation_en: Leaders approve projects when resource needs and expected value are explicit. Identifying resource needs up front prevents stalled projects.
questions.explanation_ar: حدّد الموارد المطلوبة والعائد المتوقع قبل طلب دعم القيادة.
questions.source: replaced old Q12 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Engage stakeholders to promote quality and safety
questions.stem: A hospital is about to launch a major EHR-related workflow change. Following Kotter's model, what should leaders do FIRST?

options.A: Establish a sense of urgency
options.B: Celebrate short-term wins
options.C: Anchor the change in the culture
options.D: Empower broad-based action

questions.explanation_en: Kotter's first step is creating urgency, followed by building a guiding coalition.
questions.explanation_ar: أول خطوة في نموذج كوتر هي خلق الشعور بالإلحاح.

questions.task_name: Assess the organization's culture of quality and safety
questions.stem: Results of the annual patient safety culture survey show low scores in 'feedback about errors.' What is the MOST appropriate next step?

options.A: Share results with staff and build targeted action plans with them
options.B: File the results as evidence for the next accreditation survey
options.C: Repeat the survey next month to confirm the low scores are real
options.D: Discipline the managers of the lowest-scoring units this quarter

questions.explanation_en: Survey value comes from closing the loop: feedback to staff and action planning.
questions.explanation_ar: شارك النتائج مع الموظفين وضع خطط عمل.

questions.task_name: Participate in activities that support the quality governance infrastructure
questions.stem: Which structure MOST commonly provides oversight of the hospital-wide quality and patient safety program on behalf of the governing body?

options.A: The finance committee, which approves the annual quality budget
options.B: A board quality and safety committee reporting to the full board
options.C: An ad hoc team convened by the CEO after each sentinel event
options.D: The marketing department, which publishes quality results externally

questions.explanation_en: A standing board quality committee is a core part of quality governance infrastructure. It monitors performance and keeps the board informed.
questions.explanation_ar: لجنة الجودة والسلامة التابعة لمجلس الإدارة هي ركيزة حوكمة الجودة.
questions.source: replaced old Q15 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Provide consultative support to the governing body and key stakeholders regarding their roles and responsibilities related to quality improvement
questions.stem: A department head says, 'Quality is the quality department's job.' Which response BEST reflects an integrated quality approach?

options.A: Agree, since the quality department owns all quality measures
options.B: Refer the comment to Human Resources as a performance concern
options.C: Quality is everyone's responsibility; the quality team facilitates
options.D: Reassign all departmental measures to the quality department staff

questions.explanation_en: In an integrated model, operational leaders own their quality while the quality function supports and coordinates.
questions.explanation_ar: الجودة مسؤولية الجميع وقسم الجودة ميسّر.

questions.task_name: Participate in activities that support the quality governance infrastructure
questions.stem: Quality, risk management, and infection prevention each track falls and CLABSI data separately, producing conflicting reports. What is the BEST action?

options.A: Let each department continue reporting independently to its committee
options.B: Integrate data and reporting through a shared committee or dashboard
options.C: Eliminate the risk management function to reduce duplicate reporting
options.D: Report only the most favorable data set to leadership and the board

questions.explanation_en: Integration reduces duplication and conflicting messages, and allows coordinated action.
questions.explanation_ar: دمج البيانات والتقارير في هيكل موحّد.

questions.task_name: Assist with the development of action plans or projects
questions.stem: Which set of elements is MOST essential in an action plan created from a quality priority?

options.A: Specific actions, an owner, a timeline, and measures of success
options.B: A mission statement, organizational chart, and list of committees
options.C: Names of staff involved in past errors and their supervisors
options.D: Only the approved budget and the purchasing plan for the project

questions.explanation_en: Action plans need actionable steps, accountability, deadlines, and measures to know whether they worked.
questions.explanation_ar: خطة العمل تحتاج إجراءات محددة ومالكاً وجدولاً زمنياً ومقاييس نجاح.
questions.source: replaced old Q18 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Advise leadership on organizational improvement opportunities
questions.stem: The quality director notices that risk-adjusted sepsis mortality has exceeded the national benchmark for three quarters. What is the BEST way to advise senior leadership?

options.A: Present trended risk-adjusted data, the benchmark, and a recommendation
options.B: Wait for a fourth quarter of data to be sure before mentioning it to anyone
options.C: Send the raw patient-level death lists directly to the CEO for review
options.D: Report it only to the ICU manager so the unit can handle it internally

questions.explanation_en: Advising leaders means turning data into a clear, trended case for action with a recommendation. Delay or unfiltered raw data does not support decisions.
questions.explanation_ar: قدّم للقيادة بيانات متتابعة معدّلة للمخاطر مع توصية واضحة بفرصة التحسين.
questions.source: replaced old Q19 (duplicate of another domain's item)

questions.task_name: Align quality and safety activities with strategic goals
questions.stem: When developing the annual quality and patient safety plan, which element is MOST important to ensure leadership support?

options.A: Listing every measure collected by every department in the organization
options.B: Using the previous year's plan unchanged to keep the approach consistent
options.C: Clear linkage of priorities and measures to strategic goals
options.D: Limiting the plan to the quality team

questions.explanation_en: Alignment with strategic goals shows value and secures leadership commitment and resources.
questions.explanation_ar: ربط خطة الجودة بالأهداف الاستراتيجية يضمن دعم القيادة.

questions.task_name: Advise leadership on organizational improvement opportunities
questions.stem: An internal review shows ED left-without-being-seen rates rising from 2% to 6% while competitors report 2%. A patient-experience survey shows long-wait complaints. What should the quality professional recommend to leadership FIRST?

options.A: Stop collecting LWBS data because the results are unfavorable this year
options.B: Add more triage nurses immediately without analyzing the causes of delay
options.C: Prioritize ED flow and charter a team to analyze causes of delay
options.D: Launch a marketing campaign highlighting the ED's quality and speed

questions.explanation_en: Converging internal and external signals point to a priority opportunity; the next step is a chartered analysis of causes, not an untested fix.
questions.explanation_ar: تقارب المؤشرات يجعل تدفق الطوارئ فرصة تحسين ذات أولوية تتطلب تحليل الأسباب.

questions.task_name: Advise leadership on organizational improvement opportunities
questions.stem: Which source would BEST help leadership identify organization-wide improvement opportunities during annual planning?

options.A: Vendor brochures describing new technology available for purchase
options.B: The opinion of the longest-serving department head on what to fix
options.C: An environmental scan of performance data, benchmarks, and feedback
options.D: Last year's project list, carried forward with minor updates only

questions.explanation_en: Opportunities are identified from multiple internal and external data sources, as in a SWOT-based environmental scan.
questions.explanation_ar: المسح البيئي الشامل للبيانات الداخلية والخارجية يكشف فرص التحسين.

questions.task_name: Advise leadership on organizational improvement opportunities
questions.stem: In a SWOT analysis, 'high nurse turnover on medical units' is classified as which element?

options.A: Strength
options.B: Opportunity
options.C: Weakness
options.D: Threat

questions.explanation_en: Strengths and weaknesses are internal; opportunities and threats are external. Internal turnover is a weakness.
questions.explanation_ar: معدل دوران التمريض عامل داخلي سلبي، أي نقطة ضعف.

questions.task_name: Assist with the development of action plans or projects
questions.stem: After the board selects 'reduce hospital-acquired pressure injuries' as a priority, what should the quality professional help develop NEXT?

options.A: A purchase order for new mattresses for all units
options.B: A project charter with an aim, scope, team, measures, and timeline
options.C: A press release announcing zero pressure injuries
options.D: A disciplinary policy for nurses with patients who develop injuries

questions.explanation_en: Once a priority is set, a charter translates it into a structured project with defined aim, scope, and measures.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد تحديد الأولوية يُعدّ ميثاق مشروع بهدف ونطاق وفريق ومقاييس.

questions.task_name: Assist with the development of action plans or projects
questions.stem: An action plan to reduce falls lists 'educate staff' and 'be more careful' with no owners or dates. Six months later, falls are unchanged. What is the MOST likely reason?

options.A: Staff did not read the action plan carefully enough to follow it
options.B: Falls cannot really be reduced in acute care hospitals at all
options.C: The falls data must be wrong
options.D: Weak actions with no owners, deadlines, or measures

questions.explanation_en: Weak, vague actions without owners or measures rarely change outcomes. Strong plans assign accountability and monitor results.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطة الضعيفة بلا مالك ولا موعد ولا قياس لا تحقق نتائج.

questions.task_name: Assist with the development of action plans or projects
questions.stem: Which tool BEST displays the sequence and timing of activities in a quality action plan?

options.A: Gantt chart
options.B: Fishbone diagram
options.C: Scatter diagram
options.D: Histogram

questions.explanation_en: A Gantt chart shows tasks against a timeline, which helps track action-plan milestones.
questions.explanation_ar: مخطط جانت يعرض المهام وتوقيتها على خط زمني.

questions.task_name: Assist with establishing priorities
questions.stem: Which combination of criteria is MOST commonly used to prioritize quality improvement opportunities?

options.A: Lowest-cost projects only, to protect the operating budget
options.B: High-risk, high-volume, problem-prone, strategically aligned
options.C: Projects that can be finished within one week by one person
options.D: Processes owned by the most outspoken department managers

questions.explanation_en: Classic prioritization focuses on high-risk, high-volume, problem-prone areas that support the strategy.
questions.explanation_ar: تُرتّب الأولويات حسب الخطورة والحجم وكثرة المشكلات والارتباط بالاستراتيجية.

questions.task_name: Assist with establishing priorities
questions.stem: A prioritization matrix scores Project X (impact 9, feasibility 3) and Project Y (impact 7, feasibility 8). Resources allow only one project this quarter. Which is the BEST recommendation?

options.A: Start both projects at the same time with half the resources each
options.B: Select Project X because impact is the only criterion that matters
options.C: Select neither project yet
options.D: Select Project Y: high impact with much greater feasibility

questions.explanation_en: Prioritization balances impact with feasibility; a high-impact project with low feasibility may fail with limited resources.
questions.explanation_ar: التوازن بين الأثر وقابلية التنفيذ يرجّح المشروع الأعلى جدوى حالياً.

questions.task_name: Assist with establishing priorities
questions.stem: Two units request help with the same priority level. One involves a sentinel-event risk in medication administration; the other involves delayed patient-education materials. Which should come first?

options.A: Both should wait until the annual quality plan has been revised
options.B: Whichever unit asked first
options.C: The education project, because it is easier and quicker to finish
options.D: The medication risk, because safety risk weighs highest

questions.explanation_en: Risk to patient safety is a dominant criterion when priorities otherwise tie.
questions.explanation_ar: مخاطر سلامة المرضى لها الوزن الأعلى عند ترتيب الأولويات.

questions.task_name: Assist with establishing priorities
questions.stem: Which technique allows a group to rank a list of improvement options by having each member distribute a limited number of votes?

options.A: Brainstorming
options.B: Multivoting
options.C: Flowcharting
options.D: Benchmarking

questions.explanation_en: Multivoting narrows and ranks options quickly by giving each member a limited number of votes.
questions.explanation_ar: التصويت المتعدد يرتّب الخيارات بتوزيع عدد محدود من الأصوات.

questions.task_name: Participate in activities that support the quality governance infrastructure
questions.stem: Department quality reports reach the board through no defined route, and some are never reviewed. What should the quality professional recommend?

options.A: Send all departmental reports directly to the CEO's email inbox each month
options.B: Define a reporting structure, calendar, and escalation to the board
options.C: Allow each department to report to the board whenever it chooses to
options.D: Stop departmental reporting altogether to reduce the reporting workload

questions.explanation_en: Quality governance infrastructure defines who reports what, when, and to whom so issues are reviewed and escalated.
questions.explanation_ar: حدّد هيكل تقارير الجودة بمواثيق اللجان وجدول التقارير ومسار التصعيد.

questions.task_name: Participate in activities that support the quality governance infrastructure
questions.stem: Which document typically describes the scope, structure, responsibilities, and reporting lines of an organization's quality program?

options.A: The quality and patient safety plan
options.B: The employee handbook and code of conduct
options.C: The annual external financial audit report
options.D: The medical staff bylaws dues schedule appendix

questions.explanation_en: The quality plan defines the governance framework, priorities, and reporting relationships for the program.
questions.explanation_ar: خطة الجودة وسلامة المرضى تحدد نطاق البرنامج وهيكله ومسؤولياته.

questions.task_name: Participate in activities that support the quality governance infrastructure
questions.stem: A hospital's quality council meets monthly but spends most time reading departmental data aloud, and no decisions are recorded. What change would MOST improve its governance value?

options.A: Remove physicians from the council so meetings move faster
options.B: Cancel the council and circulate the data by email instead
options.C: Use exception-based dashboards and focus on decisions and actions
options.D: Increase meetings to weekly while keeping the same agenda format

questions.explanation_en: Effective committees review exceptions and trends, make decisions, and track actions; reading data aloud adds no value.
questions.explanation_ar: ركّز اجتماعات المجلس على الاستثناءات واتخاذ القرارات ومتابعتها.

questions.task_name: Align quality and safety activities with strategic goals
questions.stem: The strategic plan's top goal is 'zero preventable harm.' Which departmental objective is BEST aligned?

options.A: Reduce the number of quality committee meetings by half this year
options.B: Cut medication errors with harm by 50% within 12 months
options.C: Renovate the staff lounge to improve morale and retention
options.D: Increase cafeteria revenue by 10% to fund new safety projects

questions.explanation_en: Aligned objectives directly contribute to the strategic goal through measurable targets.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف الإداري المتوافق يسهم مباشرة في الهدف الاستراتيجي بقياس واضح.

questions.task_name: Align quality and safety activities with strategic goals
questions.stem: A hospital runs 40 small QI projects, but none of its five strategic quality goals improved last year. What is the BEST interpretation?

options.A: More projects should be started so that some of the goals improve
options.B: The strategic goals are unachievable and should be lowered next year
options.C: Efforts are scattered and not aligned with strategic priorities
options.D: Staff are not working hard enough on their assigned QI projects

questions.explanation_en: Many unaligned projects dilute resources; projects should be chosen to advance strategic aims.
questions.explanation_ar: كثرة المشاريع غير المرتبطة بالاستراتيجية تشتّت الجهود والموارد.

questions.task_name: Identify resource needs to improve quality
questions.stem: A sepsis team needs real-time data to monitor bundle compliance, but abstraction takes a nurse 20 hours per week. What is the BEST resource request?

options.A: Request analyst or IT support to automate an EHR report
options.B: Ask physicians to self-report their bundle compliance each week
options.C: Stop measuring compliance for now
options.D: Ask the abstracting nurse to work overtime for as long as needed

questions.explanation_en: Identifying the right resource (data/IT support) addresses the bottleneck sustainably.
questions.explanation_ar: اطلب دعماً تقنياً لأتمتة التقارير بدل الاعتماد على الجهد اليدوي.

questions.task_name: Identify resource needs to improve quality
questions.stem: When identifying resource needs for a QI project, which category is MOST often overlooked?

options.A: Protected time for front-line staff
options.B: Meeting room bookings for the project team
options.C: Office supplies and printing for storyboards
options.D: Refreshments for team meetings and celebrations

questions.explanation_en: Staff time is the main resource in improvement work and is frequently underestimated.
questions.explanation_ar: الوقت المخصص للموظفين هو أهم موارد مشاريع التحسين وغالباً يُغفل.

questions.task_name: Identify resource needs to improve quality
questions.stem: The cost of a falls-prevention program is SAR 200,000 per year. Each injurious fall costs about SAR 50,000, and the program is expected to prevent 8 injurious falls. What is the expected net financial benefit?

options.A: SAR 0, because the cost equals the avoided falls

questions.explanation_en: Avoided cost 8 × 50,000 = 400,000; minus program cost 200,000 = net benefit 200,000.
questions.explanation_ar: التكلفة المتجنبة 400 ألف ناقص تكلفة البرنامج 200 ألف = صافي 200 ألف.

questions.task_name: Identify resource needs to improve quality
questions.stem: Leadership approves a project but provides no budget. What should the quality professional do?

options.A: Use another department's unspent budget without asking for approval
options.B: Cancel the project without discussion
options.C: Negotiate scope or timeline with the sponsor to fit resources
options.D: Proceed with the original scope and timeline and hope for success

questions.explanation_en: Scope, time, and resources must be balanced; the sponsor decides trade-offs.
questions.explanation_ar: وازن النطاق والوقت مع الموارد المتاحة بالتنسيق مع الراعي.

questions.task_name: Assess the organization's culture of quality and safety
questions.stem: A tool that asks staff about teamwork, handoffs, and nonpunitive response to error is measuring what?

options.A: Financial performance of clinical units
options.B: Patient experience of hospital care
options.C: Clinical outcomes of high-risk patients
options.D: Patient safety culture

questions.explanation_en: Safety culture surveys assess staff perceptions of teamwork, communication, and response to error.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه الأسئلة تقيس ثقافة سلامة المرضى لدى الموظفين.

questions.task_name: Assess the organization's culture of quality and safety
questions.stem: Safety culture survey results show 85% positive scores among managers but only 40% among front-line nurses on the same units. What does this MOST likely indicate?

options.A: The survey was answered incorrectly by many of the front-line nurses
options.B: Managers' scores are more accurate
options.C: A leader–staff perception gap that should be explored
options.D: The units have an excellent safety culture that needs no further work

questions.explanation_en: Large differences between leaders and front-line staff signal a disconnect; leaders should seek to understand staff experience.
questions.explanation_ar: الفجوة بين تقييم المدراء والموظفين تحتاج استكشافاً ومعالجة.

questions.task_name: Assess the organization's culture of quality and safety
questions.stem: The quality team wants to understand WHY a unit's safety culture scores are low. Which follow-up method is BEST?

options.A: Comparing the unit's scores with another hospital's results only
options.B: Facilitated focus groups with unit staff to explore the results
options.C: Asking the unit manager to write an explanation of the scores
options.D: Repeating the same survey immediately to see if scores change

questions.explanation_en: Qualitative methods such as focus groups explain the reasons behind survey scores.
questions.explanation_ar: مجموعات النقاش المركزة تكشف أسباب انخفاض نتائج الثقافة.

questions.task_name: Engage stakeholders to promote quality and safety
questions.stem: A hospital plans to redesign discharge processes. Which stakeholder group is MOST often left out but should be engaged early?

options.A: Medical students rotating on the units
options.B: Patients and family advisors
options.C: Equipment vendors supplying the units
options.D: The finance department and payers

questions.explanation_en: Patient and family advisors bring the end-user perspective and improve the design of care processes.
questions.explanation_ar: إشراك المرضى وأسرهم مبكراً يحسن تصميم العمليات.

questions.task_name: Engage stakeholders to promote quality and safety
questions.stem: Using a stakeholder analysis, the team finds the chief of surgery has high influence but low interest in a new safety initiative. What is the BEST strategy?

options.A: Link the initiative to surgical priorities and keep the chief informed
options.B: Ignore the chief because a low-interest stakeholder will not interfere
options.C: Escalate the chief's lack of interest to the board immediately
options.D: Assign the chief to the team as the project scribe to build interest

questions.explanation_en: High-influence stakeholders must be engaged deliberately by connecting the initiative to their interests.
questions.explanation_ar: أصحاب النفوذ العالي يجب إشراكهم بربط المبادرة باهتماماتهم.

questions.task_name: Provide consultative support to the governing body and key stakeholders regarding their roles and responsibilities related to quality improvement
questions.stem: New board members ask what their responsibility is for quality. What is the BEST consultative support?

options.A: Explain that quality is managed by staff and needs little board attention
options.B: Orient them on their oversight duty, key measures, and probing questions
options.C: Give them copies of all raw incident reports so they see every event
options.D: Ask them to audit patient charts personally once a quarter on the units

questions.explanation_en: Board education on oversight roles and key questions strengthens governance of quality.
questions.explanation_ar: تعريف أعضاء المجلس بدورهم الرقابي على الجودة ضمن مسؤوليتهم الائتمانية.

questions.task_name: Provide consultative support to the governing body and key stakeholders regarding their roles and responsibilities related to quality improvement
questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes the role of the medical staff in the quality program?

options.A: Medical staff approve the hospital's operating and capital budgets
options.B: Medical staff have no formal role in quality oversight or review
options.C: Accountable to the board for practitioner quality, including peer review
options.D: Medical staff report quality issues only to the quality department

questions.explanation_en: The organized medical staff oversees practitioner quality (credentialing, peer review) and is accountable to the board.
questions.explanation_ar: الطاقم الطبي مسؤول أمام المجلس عن جودة ممارسة الأطباء.

questions.task_name: Promote engagement and inter-professional teamwork
questions.stem: A QI team includes nurses who rarely speak during meetings dominated by physicians. What should the facilitator do?

options.A: Use round-robin input or nominal group technique so all contribute
options.B: Let the physicians make the decisions since they speak the most
options.C: Hold meetings only by email so that quieter members can write instead
options.D: Remove the quiet nurses from the team and recruit more vocal members

questions.explanation_en: Structured participation methods balance voices and promote interprofessional engagement.
questions.explanation_ar: استخدم أساليب منظمة مثل الدور الدائري لضمان مشاركة الجميع.

questions.task_name: Promote engagement and inter-professional teamwork
questions.stem: Which program provides evidence-based tools to improve teamwork and communication among healthcare professionals?

options.A: ISO 9001 quality management
options.B: HEDIS performance measures
options.C: HCAHPS communication survey
options.D: TeamSTEPPS

questions.explanation_en: TeamSTEPPS (AHRQ/DoD) teaches leadership, communication, situation monitoring, and mutual support.
questions.explanation_ar: برنامج TeamSTEPPS يعزز العمل الفريقي والتواصل.

questions.task_name: Promote engagement and inter-professional teamwork
questions.stem: Staff engagement scores dropped after a merger, and two QI teams stopped meeting. What is the BEST leadership response?

options.A: Recognize contributions, clarify shared goals, and involve staff
options.B: Replace the team leaders with outside consultants to restart the work
options.C: Pause all improvement work for a year until the merger settles down
options.D: Mandate meeting attendance with penalties for anyone who is absent

questions.explanation_en: Engagement is rebuilt through recognition, shared purpose, and involvement, not coercion.
questions.explanation_ar: استعادة المشاركة تتم بالتقدير ووضوح الأهداف وإشراك الموظفين.

questions.task_name: Promote engagement and inter-professional teamwork
questions.stem: Which practice MOST promotes engagement of front-line staff in quality improvement?

options.A: Assigning all projects from the top
options.B: Posting unit quality data once a year at the annual staff meeting
options.C: Sharing results only with managers to avoid confusing front-line staff
options.D: Unit huddle-board results with staff choosing ideas to test

questions.explanation_en: Visible data plus ownership of ideas builds staff engagement in improvement.
questions.explanation_ar: عرض النتائج للموظفين وإشراكهم في اختيار أفكار التحسين يعزز المشاركة.
